# FragAPI

> FragAPI is an open-source HTTP API for automating fragment.com: buy Telegram Stars and Telegram Premium for any username, look up Telegram gift models, and top up a balance in TON. No KYC and no wallet seed phrase are needed; purchases are paid from a prepaid balance.

This site (fragapi.com) is the landing page and the dashboard. The documentation lives at https://docs.fragapi.com, which has its own llms.txt with a link to every page.

- Base URL: `https://api.fragapi.com/v1`. Sandbox environment: `https://sandbox-api.fragapi.com/v1`.
- Auth: send `Authorization: Bearer <API token>`. Tokens are created at https://fragapi.com/dashboard/api-tokens.
- Purchases are charged to the account balance, with a commission of about 2% (1.8% plus the network fee).
- Limits, errors, the typical flow and every endpoint are described in the docs `llms.txt` below. Read it before writing code against the API.

## Docs

- [Docs index for LLMs](https://docs.fragapi.com/llms.txt): basics, limits, errors and a link to every docs page as Markdown
- [Full docs in one file](https://docs.fragapi.com/llms-full.txt): guides and the full API reference
- [OpenAPI spec](https://api.fragapi.com/openapi.json): machine-readable schema of every endpoint
- [Docs website](https://docs.fragapi.com): the same content for people

## Python SDK

- [fragapi on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/fragapi/): official async client, `pip install fragapi`, Python 3.10+
- [SDK source](https://github.com/apelsynca/fragapi-python): one `FragAPI` client with a method per endpoint
- [SDK examples](https://github.com/apelsynca/fragapi-python/tree/main/examples/): runnable scripts for each area

```python
import asyncio

from fragapi import FragAPI


async def main() -> None:
    fragapi = FragAPI(token="YOUR_API_TOKEN")
    me = await fragapi.get_me()
    print(me.balance)
    await fragapi.buy_stars(username="synca", quantity=50)


asyncio.run(main())
```
